slice.verified_scope: Cargo source replacement can redirect a registry or git-dependency source to another data source including an exact local copy; .cargo/config.toml source tables can define a directory source and replace crates-io with that source via replace-with; directory sources are suitable for vendored dependencies and are primarily managed by cargo vendor.
slice.not_verified_scope: No Cargo process was executed. This slice does not verify that cargo build/test succeeds fully offline for a concrete project, that every dependency class is covered by the vendored directory, or that scheduled Chat exposes a Cargo process executor.
slice.scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to the pinned source-replacement documentation semantics. It must not be broadened into proof of fully offline build/test execution or Chat-native process execution.
